ranked_evidence.title: WB Group reveals Lanca cruise missile with payload capacity of hundreds of kilograms - Janes
ranked_evidence.snippet: # WB Group reveals Lanca cruise missile with payload capacity of hundreds of kilograms A demonstrator of WB Group's Lanca cruise missile displayed during MSPO 2025. Poland's WB Group revealed a demonstrator of its Lanca (Lance) cruise missile at the MSPO 2025 defence exhibition in Kielce, Poland, in September 2025. The Lanca is designed to be built with Polish-made components and delivered by WB Group and local partners, WB Group spokesperson Remigiusz Wilk told *Janes* on 8 October. *Janes* has learnt that it could navigate in a GPS-denied environment, and that the missile is equipped with an electro-optical sensor, which will be used for navigation (waypoint recognition) and target identification. ### WB Group reveals Lanca cruise missile with payload capacity of hundreds of kilograms

ranked_evidence.title: WB Group to start 155 mm shell production in 2026 - Janes
ranked_evidence.snippet: # WB Group to start 155 mm shell production in 2026. Three 155 mm artillery shells seen at WB Group premises in Poland in December 2025, at the announcement that the company would start manufacturing them. Poland's WB Group has begun developing 155 mm artillery ammunition, the company announced on 11 December. The group's CEO, Piotr Wojciechowski, said at the announcement that projectiles have already undergone initial trials, which have proved promising, adding that the company will be ready for serial production by December 2026. *Janes*  has learnt that WB Group had already mastered production from the initial processing of steel forgings from local suppliers, and is currently testing inert rounds. Wojciechowski said the certification process is being conducted along two parallel tracks, in Poland and abroad, with the intention that WB Group will be able to offer its ammunition globally. ### WB Group to start 155 mm shell production in 2026. ## See how Janes delivers verified defence intelligence for faster, safer decisions.

ranked_evidence.title: CJP's parliament march from Jantar Mantar: India's 'cockroach' protest continues a day after police crackdown - BBC
ranked_evidence.snippet: # India's 'cockroach' protest continues a day after police crackdown. Thousands have gathered again in the Indian capital Delhi a day after a police crackdown on supporters of India's Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), a youth-led movement seeking education reforms and resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan. Tens of thousands of young men and women had turned up for Monday's protest and tried to march on parliament, defying a police ban. Police said 118 of their personnel were also injured and 70 protesters have been detained. Police and Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government have not commented on the use of sticks and tear gas against protesters. The meeting took place against the backdrop of tens of thousands of people turning up from all over the country to participate in the CJP's call to march to parliament on the opening day of the monsoon session.

ranked_evidence.title: Farmers call off Delhi march after assurance of talks with Union agriculture minister Shivraj Singh Chouh - The Times of India
ranked_evidence.snippet: BATHINDA/PATIALA: Haryana Police showed up in force to intercept hundreds of farmers on Tuesday to prevent them from gathering at New Delhi’s Kisan Ghat.Organised under the banner of Desh Bachao Morcha, a coalition of farmer groups, the protesters were marching to oppose a proposed India-US trade agreement.Police erected multi-layer barricades along the Amritsar–Delhi national highway at Shambhu and Khanauri borders, mirroring the heavy blockades seen during the Feb 2024 “Delhi Chalo-2” protests over a legal guarantee for minimum support price.Prevented from marching forward, farmers held a protest at the Shambhu border. Villagers from Ghagga, Patran, and nearby areas in Patiala district supported them.Women prepared langar at the local gurdwara and sent tractor-trailers loaded with food to the stranded protesters.The standoff ended when Haryana agriculture minister Shyam Singh Rana reached Shambhu and said all detained activists would be released and the farmers will get a formal meeting with Union agriculture minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan.The Desh Bachao Morcha is demanding that the Centre make all documents related to the proposed India-US trade agreement public.

ranked_evidence.title: Police clash with youth-led Cockroach Janta Party protesters in New Delh - The Jerusalem Post
ranked_evidence.snippet: ## The months-old movement and the planned protest are seen as the biggest public challenge to Prime Minister Narendra Modi in his third term in office, drawing millions of supporters. A police officer monitors CCTV footage from a mobile command-and-control vehicle at the Jantar Mantar protest site, where CJP supporters have gathered ahead of a planned march to Parliament on the opening day of the Monsoon Session, demanding the resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan. Supporters of India's youth-led "cockroach" movement were caned by police on Monday as they sought to march on parliament in the capital, New Delhi, despite authorities denying permission for the protest. A police decision to forcibly move hunger-striking activist Sonam Wangchuk to hospital on Saturday has galvanized the movement, with thousands of supporters arriving through the night at the protest site of Jantar Mantar in the heart of New Delhi for the march on the opening day of parliament's monsoon session.
